variants.design: Basic walker: slender bald moss-green zombie, torn beige sleeveless buttoned vest, charcoal trousers and worn black sneakers with off-white soles. Match the original reference outfit.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: production overhead pixel-art animation sprite sheet for a Phaser top-down zombie game.
Reference image 1 shows the REQUIRED CAMERA and facing: the old game's overhead zombie animation sprites. Reference image 2 supplies the NEW character design and chunky pixel-art style only. Translate that character into the camera of image 1.
CAMERA IS CRITICAL: orthographic straight DOWN from directly above at 90 degrees. Show the TOP of the bald skull, shoulders, upper back, forearms and shoes emerging underneath. Standing characters are compact overhead silhouettes, NOT tall upright figures. All characters face screen RIGHT (+X). Head is on the right side of the torso, back on the left, shoulders run vertically on the page. Hands extend right. Do NOT show a front view, side elevation or isometric character. Fallen bodies are lying flat on the ground viewed from directly above.
STYLE: detailed crisp pixel art, dark pixel outlines, moss-green skin, muted ragged clothes, limited shaded palette, small visible red eyes only if appropriate to overhead view. Clean readable pixel clusters, no blur. Light from upper left, very subtle contact shade only.
LAYOUT: wide 2:1 canvas, ideally 2048x1024. EXACTLY 8 columns and 4 rows of equal square cells. Invisible grid. Each sprite centered on its torso/pelvis in its cell, identical body scale throughout, at least 15% transparent padding from every cell boundary, no overlapping or cut-off limbs. Do not fill empty cells. 25 required poses:
ROW 1 cells 1-8: WALK frames 0-7, continuous 8-frame gait cycle with alternating left/right foot contacts and shoulder/arm sway.
ROW 2 cells 1-6: ATTACK frames 0-5, wind-up, raise claws, reach, full forward strike, retract, recovery. Cells 7-8: HIT frames 0-1, impact recoil and recovery.
ROW 3 cells 1-8: DEATH frames 0-7, standing, stagger, buckle, begin falling, falling, floor impact, settle, completely motionless prone body. The change from compact standing silhouette to an elongated horizontal fallen body must be clear. Feet toward left, head toward right in final prone position.
ROW 4 cell 1: CORPSE, identical prone pose to death frame 7 with small dark dried blood underneath. ROW 4 cells 2-8 must remain completely empty transparent.
CHARACTER VARIANT: Basic walker: slender bald moss-green zombie, torn beige sleeveless buttoned vest, charcoal trousers and worn black sneakers with off-white soles. Match the original reference outfit.
Background is TRUE alpha transparency. No opaque background, no checkerboard drawing, no text, labels, numbers, border, UI or props. Each occupied cell contains only one zombie frame.
